title: End‑to‑End Testing with Cypress
description: Overview of E2E testing: simulating user interactions in a real browser.

slides.title: What is E2E Testing?
slides.content:
# Full Application Testing

E2E tests run your app in a real browser and simulate user actions (click, type, navigate). They give you the highest confidence but are slower to run and maintain.

**Cypress** is the most popular E2E testing framework for Vue apps. It provides:
- Time travel debugging
- Automatic waiting
- Real‑time reloading
- Screenshots and videos

slides.title: Writing a Cypress Test
Setup with Vite
slides.content:
In a Vite project, you can add Cypress easily:

```bash
npm install -D cypress
npx cypress open
```

Add a test script in `package.json`:
```json
"test:e2e": "cypress run"
```

For CI, you can run headless tests.

Note: Cypress tests run against your built app, so you need to serve it first (or use `cypress` with `vite` plugin).

quizData.question: What is a key difference between unit/component tests and E2E tests?

options.text: E2E tests test the entire application in a real browser
E2E tests cannot test user interactions
E2E tests are written in a different language

quizData.explanation: E2E tests simulate real user interactions in a browser, testing the full stack.
